query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN tag_count >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as projects_with_5plus_tags,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tag_count < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as projects_under_5_tags,
  COUNT(*) as total_projects
FROM (
  SELECT p.id, COUNT(pt.tagId) as tag_count
  FROM projects p
  LEFT JOIN projectTags pt ON p.id = pt.projectId
  GROUP BY p.id
) as subquery;
